name: Rabbit Samurai
description: Rabbit Samurai is on a big adventure to help his Sensei. Your goal is to find all mice and rescue them from the wolf's lair. Use the rope and sticking grappling hook to fly over the land. Launch yourself from the ninja cannon, collect all carrots and find hidden crystals. Avoid dangerous spikes!
longDescription: Rabbit Samurai is on a big adventure to help his Sensei. Your goal is to find all mice and rescue them from the wolf's lair. Use the rope and sticking grappling hook to fly over the land. Launch yourself from the ninja cannon, collect all carrots and find hidden crystals. Avoid dangerous spikes!
gameplay: Move with arrow keys. Click to shoot the grappling hook. Swing between obstacles and narrow spaces. Collect items for points. Save mice to progress. Hint: Timing your swings by watching the pendulum's movement is essential for those tricky turns!
